capabilities.title: Traces table live refresh
capabilities.requirement: The Traces table reflects live buffer state: it periodically re-polls viz.query.traces so it transitions out of the 'No traces yet' empty state once telemetry lands and keeps rows current as spans flow, without a manual reload, preserving the P-068 anomaly-first order + Errors-only filter + active sort + keyboard focus across refreshes.
capabilities.observed_gap: The Traces table's viz.query.traces runs once at mount (row_count 0 before data lands) and never re-polls, so it reads 'No traces yet' / stale even as spans flow (the constellation polls every 1s; the table does not) — reads as broken for an observability app under live data.

verification.acceptance: With live telemetry the Traces table transitions 'No traces yet' -> populated rows on a periodic re-poll without a manual reload, preserving Errors-only (aria-pressed) + active sort (aria-sort) + focus across refreshes; proven by vitest DOM-shape locks (traces.query re-invoked >=2x on a fake interval timer, a later response updates rows, timer cleared on unmount with no leaked call, a post-first-load re-poll rejection keeps last-good rows; empty->populated announces once via the polite StatusLiveRegion, not per-tick/assertive; document.activeElement + aria-pressed/aria-sort unchanged across a rows update) + the p4-live-trace-list/p1-traces axe sweeps green (0 critical/serious, 0 new baseline tuple) + the /implement P3 operator warm-boot leave-running VISUAL verify (table populates on screen under inject_demo telemetry with filter intact; jsdom getBoundingClientRect=0x0 + obs-log are layout-blind). Pure-visual/render capability (auto-refresh, no user-operated control) -> affordance-EXEMPT per verification-matrix-contract.md Affordance honesty.

capabilities.title: Traces table internal scroll (fixed hero + toolbar)

verification.acceptance: The Traces route bounds itself to the shell-allotted viewport height (calc(100vh - titlebar - tabnav - footer), overflow:hidden) and the trace table flex-fills the remainder with its own overflow-y:auto scroll region (min-height:0) — so the constellation hero + the Errors-only/sort toolbar + a sticky opaque (--color-base) thead stay fixed AND the whole dashboard shows NO outer page scrollbar (footer stays visible) at any window size, instead of a hardcoded max-height.
